lines.text: Archers who used both hands to sling stones and shoot arrows came to David at Ziklag.
Gadites with faces like lions defected to David, and they crossed the Jordan in the third month while it overflowed.
David met Benjamites and men from Judah, and the Spirit came upon Amasai, who pledged they were David's.
Men from Manasseh defected to David, helped him against raiders, and he gained a great army like the army of Pharaoh.
The men of war came to Hebron to make David king over all Israel and feasted with him three days.
